version: PainEngine .7 broad round + .8 targeted regression and export

usage.note: Shared rounded account counter; parent owns final usage accounting

evidence.expected: Two source-material IDs render their own material on submeshes.
evidence.actual: Importer returned 2 meshes and source IDs 0 and 1; real game frame showed split magenta/blue Suzanne. Runtime enumerated the map.
evidence.action: Imported the real multi-material Blender Suzanne fixture through frozen .7 asset.import, then loaded it in the standalone gameplay project.

evidence.expected: Change one source slot, reject invalid ID, and clear common override to recover per-slot rendering.
evidence.actual: changed=1, unknownIdRejected=1, overrideSet=1, overrideCleared=1, slotRestored=1; project.scene steps all status 0 and reported preserved slot map.
evidence.action: Called GetMaterialSlots/SetMaterialSlot with actual source IDs, rejected uint32 max, set/cleared whole-model material; project.scene set slot 1 to a different .mat.

evidence.expected: Per-source material assignments survive scene reopen and SaveGame.
evidence.actual: .7 scene save/reopen preserved slot map; .7 SaveGame did not assert slot restore. On final8, rebuilt upgraded project and saved a real hit round (frame 145, hits=1), exited; a separate Runtime process loaded round-1 and logged slots=2 with source IDs 0 and 1, variant path on ID 1, loaded elapsed=2.4 hits=1 and exited 0. Final8 project.scene save/new/load retained projectData.materialSlots for source ID 1. Narrow final8 test closes the .7 SaveGame restore gap.
evidence.action: After coordinator provided final8 frozen Runtime, upgraded the existing CLI project to a separate Final8Bomber copy and rebuilt it; exercised hit+SaveGame in one process, loaded in a second process with slot logging, plus project.scene save/new/load.

evidence.expected: A masked/translucent material clips its silhouette; toggling castShadows changes its ground shadow.
evidence.actual: Masked alpha 0 clipped the magenta submesh; opaque/castShadows true showed the model shadow, and false removed it. Real D3D BMP comparisons.
evidence.action: Captured paused standalone frames with identical scene/camera and changed only material 1 blend/castShadows.

evidence.expected: Visible distinct texture regions follow imported UVs.
evidence.actual: The simple control showed two large yellow/blue texture regions on its face in the opaque comparison frame.
evidence.action: Imported Blender four-color UV fixture, rotated its plane toward the orthographic camera, assigned the imported BaseMap, then captured standalone D3D frame.

evidence.expected: Trace reaches a target and increments gameplay hit count.
evidence.actual: HIT unit id=7 t=1.95s trace=Hit; HUD hit count advanced to 1 and hit frame dump was captured.
evidence.action: Ran the Tired Bomber standalone game; a moving bomb issued an exact downward scene ray against the imported target.

evidence.expected: Channels select separate world and unit targets.
evidence.actual: channel=1 -> ground; channel=2 -> unit.
evidence.action: At startup traced same unit with channels 1 and 2.

evidence.expected: Orthographic framing and view-plane setup produce a stable gameplay view and changed LOD only on zoom.
evidence.actual: Actual game frames at Y=24 and Y=8 were captured; completed frame logs retained LOD1 for the screen-height probe.
evidence.action: Standalone camera used orthographic=true, viewPlane=2, orthoHeight=24; game moved camera Y from 24 to 8 while frame diagnostics reported screen-height LOD.

evidence.expected: Per-component LOD counts and culling respond to camera and draw distance.
evidence.actual: Completed-frame logs listed both components, camera ranges, perLOD buckets, hidden/frustum counts; screenshot panel showed LOD1 selection.
evidence.action: Observed real InstancedMeshComponent screen-height and distance LOD in standalone frames.

evidence.expected: Panel identifies target, LOD thresholds and culling reasons.
evidence.actual: Panel displayed target index, LOD0/1/2 thresholds and CPU submission counters; completed logs included hidden/frustum and perLOD counts.
evidence.action: Captured real runtime LOD panel and changed camera distance/zoom during play.

evidence.expected: Previous completed frame exposes valid counters and LOD component detail.
evidence.actual: valid=1 at indices 59/109/149 with draw, instance, visible, culled values and two LOD records.
evidence.action: Read GetCompletedFrameStats in ProjectGame::PreUpdate during actual standalone frames.

evidence.expected: Counters advance and a BMP can be written from a game frame.
evidence.actual: Frame indices advanced 59→109→149; draw calls 40→46→41; runtime wrote 1000x500 frame and hit BMPs.
evidence.action: Collected completed-frame counters and real FrameDump output during gameplay.

evidence.expected: Multiple instances submit/render, with LOD buckets.
evidence.actual: Frame counters reported instances=71/87 and panel showed marker group, LOD thresholds and selection.
evidence.action: Viewed the gameplay marker InstancedMesh and renderer panel in standalone.

evidence.expected: Validation and simplifier return usable mesh and lower triangle count.
evidence.actual: Sphere triangles 224→130; simplification error 0; configured mesh valid. This is a small in-game API probe.
evidence.action: Validated procedural cube and simplified a dense sphere inside the real project initialization.

evidence.expected: Hit produces a visible timed particle burst.
evidence.actual: HIT event created 256 GPU spark burst; hit BMP contains bright burst on the floor.
evidence.action: Let the real bomb hit spawn GPU sparks and captured the hit frame.

evidence.expected: UI label displays hit/miss counts.
evidence.actual: HUD showed hits=0 then hits=1 after real trace hit.
evidence.action: Observed HUD label in the real game while score changed.

evidence.expected: Derived Game fields and references resume from SaveGame.
evidence.actual: Second process restored elapsed=2.4, hits=1, units=5, active sparks reference/timer and paused simulation.
evidence.action: Saved custom ProjectGame fields after a hit in one standalone process and loaded slot in a new process.

evidence.expected: Subsystem initializes, gets scene-ready, ticks, remains accessible and closes.
evidence.actual: initialized, ready Main, GetSubsystem available, periodic Tick alive after >5s, closing Main; exit 0.
evidence.action: Ran standalone for 360 frames with BomberSessionDiagnostics and observed its full lifecycle.
Ran the frozen SDK ProjectTools AddClass action to generate R3WizardProbe, built it, then created and selected it through project.scene.
evidence.expected: Create a registered game component from the editor wizard.
evidence.actual: Generator created the component source; rebuild registered it and the editor API instantiated type R3WizardProbe. The actual desktop wizard UI was not driven.

evidence.action: Inserted an intentional #error into R3WizardProbe.cpp and used the official launcher build, checked the active module SHA256, then launched the prior DLL.
evidence.expected: A failed candidate build preserves the old module and it remains runnable.
evidence.actual: Build exited 1 with C1189; active Game.dll SHA256 was unchanged, old DLL launched with exit 0, source was restored and a subsequent build succeeded.

evidence.action: Changed startupScene to a separate Alternate.scene.json, launched standalone Runtime, then restored Project.json.
evidence.expected: The selected alternate scene becomes the initial gameplay scene.
evidence.actual: Runtime exit 0 and the game subsystem logged scene ready: Alternate Start.

evidence.action: Selected the imported target, UV control, multi-selected both and selected the sun through project.scene.
evidence.expected: Pick objects and manage single/group scene selection in the viewport.
evidence.actual: Editor scene API returned the expected component IDs for every selection; desktop viewport picking/focus remains unverified.

evidence.action: Ran session.lifecycle with two scenes and also Play/Stop/Play/Stop in the actual Tired Bomber editor host.
evidence.expected: Subsystem survives scene changes in one session and sees lifecycle callbacks.
evidence.actual: Generic session API reported ready=2, closing=2, ticks=10; custom subsystem got fresh initialize/ready/closing per Play session. I did not compare a custom subsystem field across two scenes.

evidence.action: Sent focus then B, W, pause/resume and stop events through project.input.
evidence.expected: Actions, bindings and subscriptions deliver game input and drive an effect.
evidence.actual: B callback fired; W moved the player from z=5 to z=1.4000025 in 45 frames; pause/resume/stop and a second Play session worked.

evidence.action: Moved the player-controlled Gameplay.Character using W through project.input.
evidence.expected: Player character moves from its authored position in response to input.
evidence.actual: Position changed z=5 to z=1.4000025; input release stopped movement.

evidence.action: Used project.input W movement and a standalone disabled CharacterController probe.
evidence.expected: CharacterController moves the Character and disabling it suppresses movement/look input.
evidence.actual: Enabled controller moved z=5→1.4000025; the disabled probe held x=-10,z=5 under W+look events.

evidence.action: Fired DebugDrawTrace at an active bomb and inspected the real runtime frame.
evidence.expected: A hit ray/normal is visible and reported with useful line statistics.
evidence.actual: Ray returned Hit at distance 6.58 with 23 debug lines; the ray itself was difficult to isolate visually in the perspective BMP.

evidence.action: Ran identical real game hits at 1.95s with GPU particle depth collision off and sorting off.
evidence.expected: Collision/sorting toggles alter the rendered particle burst.
evidence.actual: Both configured variants and same hit time were confirmed; burst images differ visually, but per-particle GPU positions are not publicly readable for exact assertions.

evidence.action: Rendered the same game at 640×480 and 320×240 through OnWindowResized.
evidence.expected: HUD, diagnostics, names and counters remain legible after resize.
evidence.actual: Counters and target label fit at 1000×500; at 640×480 the LOD panel overlaps the game HUD, and at 320×240 the panel abbreviates/clips text and fully covers the HUD. Cyrillic was not exercised.

evidence.action: Used EngineModuleVfs to resolve /Game for frames, SaveSlots and imported assets in standalone and editor-host sessions.
evidence.expected: Host lifecycle/VFS/active-session services provide project paths and callbacks.
evidence.actual: Game lifecycle was observed and project writes worked, but Runtime logged local VFS/no host service; BaseEngine service injection was not exercised.

evidence.action: Assigned and cleared the shared material override through project.scene, retaining the two imported per-source slots.
evidence.expected: Assign/remove .mat on a model and return to original per-slot material behavior.
evidence.actual: Override set and empty-path clear both returned status 0; slot map remained unchanged.

evidence.action: Changed imported Tint values and used the material graph editor preset, apply, undo/redo and revert actions.
evidence.expected: Material parameters change and render in the preview/game.
evidence.actual: Tint alpha/color changes affected the visible submesh; graph preset produced new BaseColor/Specular HLSL and was reverted to saved values.

evidence.action: Opened the real Material Graph Editor Qt window through the hidden commandlet and saved/reverted a graph.
evidence.expected: Edit HLSL in material editor, preview, save, and revert.
evidence.actual: nativePreviewWindow=true; graph preset/apply/undo/redo/revert worked and returned HLSL, but the text HLSL editor UI path was not tested.

evidence.action: Assigned a deliberately invalid HLSL material to one Suzanne source slot and ran the standalone game.
evidence.expected: Bad shader errors are clear and only the affected submesh uses the error fallback.
evidence.actual: Runtime logged HLSL X3000 plus undeclared param/texture warnings; checkerboard fallback appeared only on the magenta submesh; process still exited 0.

evidence.action: Compared translucent, masked and opaque submesh materials with twoSided set in the actual .mat assets.
evidence.expected: Blend/mask/two-sided settings affect the rendered submesh.
evidence.actual: Masked alpha clipped one half; opaque and translucent captures differed. I did not make a separate backface/cull comparison for twoSided.

evidence.action: Captured standalone frames with the same point lights enabled and both disabled in an alternate scene.
evidence.expected: Point light intensity affects object/ground lighting.
evidence.actual: The enabled scene had visible brighter/warmer gradients around the target/floor; disabling both lights made ground color flatter; both runs exited 0.

evidence.action: Created the standard directional light and compared imported-model material shadow casts with castShadows on/off.
evidence.expected: Directional light plus shadow settings give imported models visible lighting and shadows.
evidence.actual: Real D3D capture showed a ground shadow with castShadows=true; the same model lost it when false.

evidence.action: Created Environment.Sky in a separate saved scene and launched the game with the perspective camera probe.
evidence.expected: Sky component visibly supplies a background behind the world.
evidence.actual: Perspective runtime image showed the gray-blue gradient behind the ground/model; no sky scene was dark navy.

evidence.action: Added a small MeshComponent subclass with Render override, called its base draw and launched actual Runtime.
evidence.expected: Custom game renderer receives a live host D3D context.
evidence.actual: Runtime logged Render context=ready and exited 0; the probe geometry was submitted.

evidence.action: Opened a copied imported .mat in the Material Graph editor via commandlet; used enable/save/preset/apply/undo/redo/revert.
evidence.expected: Graph editor hosts a real preview, compiles/updates HLSL and restores saved graph.
evidence.actual: nativePreviewWindow=true; graph/HLSL changed after preset and revert restored original graph; commandlet exit 0.

evidence.action: Set and read GameSettings in standalone project while switching Forward/Deferred/Custom.
evidence.expected: VSync/AA/render mode persist as current session settings and select a rendering path.
evidence.actual: Runtime logged vsync=0 aa=1 and actual rendering mode 0/1/2; three modes rendered, Deferred showed its G-buffer overlay.

evidence.action: Ran the standalone game separately in Forward, Deferred and Custom on the same frozen .7 project.
evidence.expected: Each renderer mode starts and renders the imported target/material slots.
evidence.actual: All three runs exited 0; screenshots show the target/UV control and their mode-specific render result.

evidence.action: Called the real Game::OnWindowResized hook during standalone frames, then read Display and completed-frame sizes.
evidence.expected: New viewport sizes render at the requested dimensions without stopping frame publication.
evidence.actual: 640×480 and 320×240 frames matched Display size; restoring 1000×500 advanced frame 59.
Frozen .7 asset.import imported the multi-material BLEND fixture to GLB with 2 meshes and the UV BLEND fixture to GLB with 1 mesh; the standalone game rendered the imported Suzanne and UV control.
evidence.action: Used frozen asset.import commandlet against supplied real Blender fixtures, then opened resulting assets in the new project.
evidence.expected: Import an actual model asset into the new project using the current importer.

evidence.actual: Both real fixtures were converted: multi-material Suzanne produced 2 meshes and source IDs 0/1; UV plane produced 1 mesh. Blender logs report glTF export completion.
evidence.action: Imported blend-suzanne-multiple.blend and blend-uv.blend with the frozen Runtime asset.import commandlet.
evidence.expected: Convert real .blend source assets through Blender importer.

evidence.actual: The UV BLEND import emitted BaseColor_0.png; the UV control rendered its yellow/blue texture regions in the real gameplay frame.
evidence.action: Imported UV BLEND fixture with embedded BaseColor texture, assigned imported material, and rendered the control plane.
evidence.expected: Import and display a texture on a mesh.

evidence.actual: Fixed-camera A/B captures show opaque imported model shadow with castShadows on and no shadow when off; masked transparency removes the visible submesh/shadow, while translucent material has no cast shadow.
evidence.action: Compared paused runtime frames with identical camera and scene while varying imported submesh material blend and castShadows.
evidence.expected: Verify imported model shadow toggling and blend/castShadows behavior.

evidence.action: Issued six frozen .8 mesh.primitive commandlets from the persona scratch with size=1 and slices=16.
evidence.actual: All six mesh.primitive calls exited 0 and returned ok=true with finite topology: cube 24 vertices/12 triangles, sphere 289/480, plane 4/2, cylinder 70/64, cone 66/32, pyramid 16/6.
evidence.expected: Six standard primitive mesh shapes return valid geometry.

evidence.action: Ran the frozen .8 project.scene commandlet on the scratch project with a small Ground nudge, history operations, and Save/New/Load.
evidence.actual: Select/move/undo/redo/undo/save/new/load all returned status 0 with empty errors. Ground position changed on move, reverted on Undo, reapplied on Redo, reverted again and remained original after load.
evidence.expected: Undo/Redo changes scene state and survives a scene save/reopen.

evidence.action: Called the frozen .8 gizmo.snap and gizmo.center commandlets with explicit fractional deltas.
evidence.actual: gizmo.snap returned [-1.5,0.5,2.5] for input [-1.6378729,0.26,2.41] at 0.5 step; gizmo.center with snap returned [3.6,0.4,-2.1].
evidence.expected: Position deltas snap to configured increments.

evidence.action: Ran camera.screen-ray at viewport center and upper-right with orthographic=false and FOV 60.
evidence.actual: Perspective ScreenPointToRay returned Success at center with direction [0,0,-1]; upper-right returned Success with direction [0.519,0.371,-0.770]. Both origins were on the near plane.
evidence.expected: Perspective camera screen rays change direction across the viewport.

evidence.action: Bounded screen-coordinate probe covered ray construction only; a Game viewport trace API call was not made.
evidence.actual: The .8 perspective screen-ray commandlet proved screen-to-ray geometry for center and corner points, but this persona did not call Game::RaycastScreen or RaycastCursor nor verify an integrated screen trace hit.
evidence.expected: Use Game::RaycastScreen/RaycastCursor from a viewport coordinate.

evidence.action: No SDK example compilation attempt was made; do not count source inspection or analogous API use as an attempt.
evidence.actual: The official SDK ReferenceExamples.cpp was not compiled in this persona run. The successful project build covers the game source but is not evidence of SDK example compilation.
evidence.expected: Compile API Reference SDK example snippets.

evidence.action: Ran official Engine/BuildSupport/Export-Project.ps1 against Final8Bomber and frozen final8 Runtime, then directly launched the packaged Runtime from its exported directory using the same Project.json/--mode game invocation as Start.cmd with --frames 90.
evidence.actual: Official Export-Project.ps1 completed with exit 0 and published a new folder with Game/, Runtime/, Start.cmd, ExportReport.json, Validation.log and GameSmoke.log. Export validation passed; the package smoke ran 3 frames. Launching the exported Runtime/EngineRuntime.exe against exported Game/Project.json completed 90 frames and exited 0.
evidence.expected: Export a project package and launch it outside the editor.
